title: Forrest Gump
synopsis: Alabama. A bench. A box of chocolates. You don't know what you're going to get. The century, for some reason, keeps happening to you.

nodes.text: Doctor says you'll wear it forever. Mama disagrees.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Heart.
There is no taking “Trust the doctor” back. Reason shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: First day of school. Nobody will let you sit. A girl named Jenny does.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Friend.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.

nodes.text: Bullies. Stones. Jenny yells run. The brace shatters off your legs.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Joy.
There is no taking “Stop and confront” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Alabama recruits you. Bear Bryant nods. You return kicks for touchdowns.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Just keep running” back. Forward shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Style.

nodes.text: Army drafts you. You meet Bubba. Bubba talks about shrimp.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Friend.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Plan—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Rain. Fire. Bubba is down. You carry him.

choices.consequence: “Go back for the others” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Loyal.

nodes.text: You meet Lieutenant Dan. He is, angry, alive, missing legs.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Play ping-pong” back. Therapy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Sit with Dan” back. Friend shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You meet a President. You show another your bullet wound.

choices.consequence: “Be polite” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Style.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Forrest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You speak at a Vietnam protest. The mic cuts out. The crowd listens anyway.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Just stand there.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Walk down” back. Modest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Jenny is on a stage in San Francisco. The crowd is, you don't know what kind, the crowd.

choices.consequence: “Run to her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Heart.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Patient—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You play ping-pong in China. You meet a different President. He, also, gets a wound shown to him.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Win the cup” back. Skill shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Lose graciously” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Style.

nodes.text: Lieutenant Dan invests your shrimp boat money in some fruit company. The fruit company is, it turns out, fine.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Don't think about it much.” The story records the instinct as “Forrest” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: You and Dan start a shrimp company in Bubba's name. The hurricane spares your boat. You make a lot of money.

choices.consequence: “Give half to Bubba's mama” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Family—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Mama is dying. You sit with her. She tells you life is a box of chocolates.

choices.consequence: “Sit till the end” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Son.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Vow—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You start running. You don't stop for years. People follow you. You start a movement by accident.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Just keep running.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Style—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Jenny finds you. There is a child. The child is, in fact, yours.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: You marry Jenny. She is sick. You know she is sick. You marry her anyway.

choices.consequence: “Love every day” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Now.
“Don't think about tomorrow” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Present.

nodes.text: Jenny dies under the tree by the church. You sit with her grave a long time.

choices.consequence: “Talk to her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Your son is small and smart. He asks if you're his dad. You tell him yes.

choices.consequence: “Read to him every night” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Father.

choices.text: Drive him to school every morning
choices.consequence: You commit to “Drive him to school every morning.” The story records the instinct as “Father” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: On the bench, telling a stranger your story. The stranger leaves. The bus arrives.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Forward—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Sit a moment more.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You walk him to the bus. You stand by the road. The feather drifts past your shoe.

choices.consequence: “Pick up the feather” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Sentiment.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Forward—follows you into whatever comes next.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You go home, put Jenny's feather in your old book, and start running again the next morning. Just because. Some things don't need a reason.
You raise Little Forrest into a kind, smart man. He becomes a teacher. You watch him from a back row at his graduation and cry exactly once, in a Forrest way, big and honest.
Mama was right. You never know what you're going to get. You eat the chocolates as they come. The bench, in town, is still there. Some days you sit on it.
